title: [GMCP 203.004.06] Operations and evidence: Legacy lifecycle compatibility and governed deprecation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-004-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP interoperates with pinned older MCP revisions through isolated compatibility adapters for initialize/initialized, ping, legacy HTTP+SSE, resource subscriptions, roots, sampling, elicitation, logging, and legacy task shapes without weakening the modern path. Version selection is deterministic, downgrade is visible, every deprecated feature has telemetry and a tested removal policy, and no legacy state crosses tenant or connection boundaries. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
